newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong consumer confidence surges - Mastercard.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong consumer confidence surges - Mastercard.

text.p: Hong Kong consumer confidence surged dramatically in the first half of 1996, Mastercard International's latest bi-annual survey showed on Wednesday.
The index rose sharply to 53.6 from 37.3 despite a belief in some quarters that Hong Kong's transfer from Britain to China next July 1 would erode consumer confidence, the company said.
It said an improved view of the economy and job prospects helped bring about the growth in confidence.

This month the government reported May-July unemployment fell to 2.9 percent from 3.1 percent in April-June and from 3.1 percent a year earlier. On Tuesday it reported June retail sales jumped six percent on the year, although they fell two percent on the month. -- Hong Kong News Room (852) 2843 6441
